arxiv-2204-06322.description: Abstract We trained a keyword spotting model using federated learning on real user devices and observed significant improvements when the model was deployed for inference on phones. To compensate for data domains that are missing from on-device training caches, we employed joint federated-centralized training.

arxiv-2212-14243.title: On an analytical method for the satellite problem revisited
arxiv-2212-14243.creator: Niccolò Pilloni, Claudio Saccon
arxiv-2212-14243.description: Abstract 1 Introduction In this note we discuss an analitical method, which goes back to Dirk Brouwer (1959 see [ 1 ] ), to compute the trajectories of an artificial satellite rotating around the Earth when the oblate shape is taken into account.

arxiv-2304-04202.title: Continuous eigenfunctions of the transfer operator for Dyson models
arxiv-2304-04202.creator: Anders Johansson, Anders Öberg, and Mark Pollicott
arxiv-2304-04202.description: Abstract . In this article we address a well known problem at the intersection of ergodic theory and statistical mechanics. We prove that there exists a continuous eigenfunction for the transfer operator corresponding to pair potentials that satisfy a square summability condition on the variations, when the inverse temperature is subcritical.

arxiv-2304-11936.title: Observation of nonlinear disclination states
arxiv-2304-11936.creator: Boquan Ren, A. A. Arkhipova, Yiqi Zhang, Y. V. Kartashov, Hongguang Wang, S. A. Zhuravitskii, N. N. Skryabin, I. V. Dyakonov, A. A. Kalinkin, S. P. Kulik, V. O. Kompanets, S. V. Chekalin, V. N. Zadkov
arxiv-2304-11936.description: Abstract Introduction of controllable deformations into periodic materials that lead to disclinations in their structure opens novel routes for construction of higher-order topological insulators hosting topological states at disclinations. Appearance of these topological states is consistent with the bulk-disclination correspondence principle, and is due to the filling anomaly that results in fractional charges to the boundary unit cells.

arxiv-2502-07298.title: Hybrid classical-quantum communication networks
arxiv-2502-07298.creator: Joseph M. Lukens a,b,c , Nicholas A. Peters b , Bing Qi d,e
arxiv-2502-07298.description: Abstract Over the past several decades, the proliferation of global classical communication networks has transformed various facets of human society. Concurrently, quantum networking has emerged as a dynamic field of research, driven by its potential applications in distributed quantum computing, quantum sensor networks, and secure communications.

arxiv-2502-12810.title: Frequency-domain alignment of heterogeneous, multidimensional separations data through complex orthogonal Procrustes analysis Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2502-12810.creator: Michael Sorochan Armstrong
arxiv-2502-12810.description: Abstract Multidimensional separations data have the capacity to reveal detailed information about complex biological samples. However, data analysis has been an ongoing challenge in the area since the peaks that represent chemical factors may drift over the course of several analytical runs along the first and second dimension retention times.

arxiv-2510-07844.title: The detection of Planck-scale physics facilitated by nonlinear quantum optics
arxiv-2510-07844.creator: Wenlin Li, Chengsong Zhao, Najmeh Eshaqi-Sani, Zhiyu Jiang, Xingli Li
arxiv-2510-07844.description: Abstract A tenet of contemporary physics is that novel physics beyond the Standard Model lurks at a scale related to the Planck length. The development and validation of a unified framework that merges general relativity and quantum physics is contingent upon the observation of Planck-scale physics.

pmc-10598261.title: Unraveling the signaling mechanism behind astrocytoma and possible therapeutics strategies: A comprehensive review
pmc-10598261.creator: Chowdhury Lutfun Nahar Metu, Sunita Kumari Sutihar, Md Sohel, Fatematuz Zohora, Akayed Hasan, Md. Thandu Miah, Tanu Rani Kar, Md. Arju Hossain, Md Habibur Rahman
pmc-10598261.description: BackgroundA form of cancer called astrocytoma can develop in the brain or spinal cord and sometimes causes death. A detailed overview of the precise signaling cascade underlying astrocytoma formation has not yet been revealed, although various factors have been investigated.

pmc-10735411.title: QUANTIFYING INTRINSIC HEALTH USING STRESS-EVOKED INFORMATION FLOW BETWEEN PHYSIOLOGICAL SYSTEMS
pmc-10735411.creator: Yan Wang, Sze Pui Tsang, Zain Khan, Daniel Malinsky, Ying Wei, Alan Cohen, Martin Picard, Sen Pei
pmc-10735411.description: As a canonical complex dynamical system, human bodies require interactions between constituent physiological systems to perform functions and maintain health status. Quantifying the dynamic interactions between organ systems using biomarkers collected in the context of psychobiological challenges may provide a novel means of measuring the energy-dependent communication processes that underlie intrinsic health.

pmc-11334422.title: Predictors for cause-specific and timing of deaths in patients with COVID-19: a cohort study in Taiwan
pmc-11334422.creator: Yung-Feng Yen, Shang-Yih Chan, Yun-Ju Lai, Muh-Yong Yen, Chu-Chieh Chen, Mei-Ju Chen
pmc-11334422.description: BackgroundThis cohort study determines the predictors for cause-specific and timing of deaths in patients with COVID-19 in Taiwan.MethodsPatients with laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 admitted to Taipei City Hospital from January 1 to July 31, 2022, were recruited in this cohort. All patients were followed up until death, discharge from the hospital, or August 31, 2022.

pmc-11598880.title: Isolation and Characterization of a Bacteriophage with Potential for the Control of Multidrug-Resistant Salmonella Strains Encoding Virulence Factors Associated with the Promotion of Precancerous Lesions
pmc-11598880.creator: Luis Amarillas, Fedra Padilla-Lafarga, Rubén Gerardo León Chan, Jorge Padilla, Yadira Lugo-Melchor, Jesús Enrique López Avendaño, Luis Lightbourn-Rojas, Mitzi Estrada-Acosta, Valery A Petrenko
pmc-11598880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Antimicrobial-resistant bacteria represent a serious threat to public health. Among these bacteria, Salmonella is of high priority because of its morbidity levels and its ability to induce different types of cancer. Aim: This study aimed to identify Salmonella strains encoding genes linked to the promotion of precancerous lesions and to isolate a bacteriophage to evaluate its preclinical potential against these bacteria.

pmc-11713344.title: Phase 1b trial on the safety, tolerability and immunogenicity of anti‐amyloid vaccine ALZ‐101 in subjects with MCI or mild AD

pmc-11713344.description: BackgroundALZ‐101 is a vaccine comprised of stabilised oligomeric Aβ42 that stimulates a humoral immune response primarily targeting a toxic, low‐abundant oligomeric form of Aβ. Part A of a clinical Phase 1b trial (ALZ‐C‐001; NCT05328115) was recently concluded with the objectives to assess the safety, tolerability and immunogenicity of ALZ‐101 in subjects with mild AD or MCI due to AD.

pmc-12490145.title: The changing face of acute low back pain management by physiotherapists, osteopaths and chiropractors in the UK: a 20-year comparison from 2003 to 2023

pmc-12968109.description: BackgroundThe Aggregate Index of Systemic Inflammation (AISI) is a novel index based on platelets, neutrophils, and lymphocytes associated with the prognosis of patients with cancer and infectious diseases. pmc-13077125.title: NMR evidence for residue-based LFER relationship in two-state folding-unfolding equilibrium of the spectrin SH3 domain in acidic solutions
pmc-13077125.creator: Seiichiro Hayashi, Daisuke Fujinami, Daisuke Kohda
pmc-13077125.description: The conformational change of a protein molecule is described by the single equilibrium constant K and the single rate constants, k (forward) and k’ (reverse). The underlying assumption is that all amino acid residues undergo state changes with perfect cooperativity. However, residue-specific measurements such as NMR often show residue-to-residue variations in these constants, indicating that proteins are not fully cooperative.

pmc-13556817.creator: C Gumbo, J Mbuthia, R Kang'ethe, J Mburu, L Atwoli
pmc-13556817.description: BackgroundSuicide and suicidal behaviour are higher among psychiatric inpatients than in the general population. Patients in forensic units have the duality of mental illness and incarceration. Few studies have looked into the prevalence of suicidal behaviour and patterns of psychiatric morbidity among the patients admitted to forensic units.

pmc-13603142.title: Effect of Melatonin Supplementation on Reproductive Performance, Hormonal Profile and Antioxidant Status in Sheep Under Subtropical Conditions
pmc-13603142.creator: Chandan Singh, J. S. Rajoriya, A. K. Singh, B. K. Ojha, Deepak Ningwal, Madhuri Dhurvey, Atul Kumar Verma, S. S. Tomar, Amit Kumar Jha, S. S. Peepar, Mahak Singh, Megha Pande, Rohit Gupta
pmc-13603142.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummarySeasonal infertility is a major challenge in sheep production, particularly during the non-breeding season under subtropical climatic conditions. Melatonin, a hormone naturally produced by the pineal gland, is known to influence seasonal reproductive activity in sheep. The present study evaluated the effect of different doses of melatonin on estrus response, conception rate, reproductive hormones, and antioxidant status in ewes during both breeding and non-breeding seasons.
